SELECT ct.workcell, COUNT(*) AS study_cnt, AVG(ct.fpy) AS avg_fpy
FROM v_cycle_time ct
JOIN v_workcell wc ON ct.workcell_id = wc.workcell_id
WHERE wc.status = 'active'
GROUP BY ct.workcell
ORDER BY avg_fpy ASC
LIMIT 10;
